summary: The new audit report (ai-os/audits/reporting_module_reaudit_2026-07-27.md) is genuinely strong, well-evidenced re-audit work confirming real gaps in PR #601/#51 with quoted test runs and audit verdicts, and the ACTIVE-CLAIMS.yaml addition is correctly formatted per Rule 11. However, the PROGRESS.md portion of this diff is corrupted and must not merge as-is: it deletes roughly 270 lines of unrelated historical progress entries for at least four other completed tasks (task-20260727-132826 PR #597 budget fix, task-20260727-100954 ERP HR gaps, task-20260727-101123 ERP PM gaps, task-20260727-093117 dependabot/construction-BoQ) and even the original detailed body of task-20260727-101145's own entry, replacing all of it with a single short summary that is misattributed under task-101145's section header instead of its own. Verified directly against the current file: two section headers (task-20260727-153104 at line 1 and task-20260727-122632 at line 83) are now orphaned with zero body content, while the content actually describing this re-audit task's own work sits mislabeled under the task-101145 header. This directly contradicts the append-only log convention explicitly established one commit earlier ('merge: resolve PROGRESS.md conflict with main, keep both'), destroys traceable history for several already-completed and audited tasks, and contradicts this same PR's own ACTIVE-CLAIMS.yaml claim that no files outside ai-os/audits/ were touched. This is exactly the class of defect the task title ('after PROGRESS.md conflict fix') was supposed to have resolved, and it has not been.
